machrek.math_digit_glyphs: Arabic-Indic U+0660-U+0669 outlines through the renamed OFL OpenLogicMachrekDigits face; LuaTeX character slots remain U+0030-U+0039
machrek.decimal_separator: source token retained; explicit U+066B macro available only for audited loci
machrek.thousands_separator: source token retained; explicit U+066C macro available only for audited loci

typed_exceptions.decision: Never set global RTL math direction or reverse TeX tokens.
evidence: W3C Arabic Mathematical Notation: text and mathematical direction are distinct
bounded LuaLaTeX probe: TRT reverses multi-digit numbers and Latin function/operator order
DAM2018ENAR scan pages 174, 189, 418, 700, and 760 use LTR formulas inside RTL Arabic prose
DAM2018ENAR PDF page 700 defines إشارة الجمع and explicitly identifies Greek sigma Σ

typed_exceptions.decision: Retain source Latin and Greek variable alphabets unless an author explicitly supplies a semantic mapping.
evidence: DAM2018ENAR PDF page 760 defines متغير while using Latin variables throughout neighboring formulas
blind alphabet substitution would conflate identifiers and mathematical constants

legacy_compatibility.reason: The archived implementation requires ArabTeX, reverses token streams, globally rebinds core math primitives, and uses legacy 8-bit fonts.

machrek_digit_font.derivation: XITS Math 1.302 with only the ASCII digit cmap slots remapped to its Arabic-Indic digit outlines and all primary names changed
